subject: Scaling rehearsal & benchmark slotting — coordination for next-week load test
messages:
From: Ops Lead <ops@stratuscloud.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: QA Manager <qa@stratuscloud.io>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scaling rehearsal + benchmark window next week

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — StratusCloud is keen to run a short rehearsal followed by a formal token-throughput benchmark before we commit to a Dedicated pool. Can your team support a ~3 hour window next week? Key asks:

- A rehearsal (dry run) to validate traffic shaping, prefix caching, and fallback behavior (30–45m)
- A 2-hour ramped load test targeting sustained 18k tokens/min (300 TPS at 60-token average) and a peak burst to ~600 TPS for 2 minutes
- A 15–30m readout with ops/qa to review logs and any QoS deviations

We can provide test payloads and our expected prompt distributions. Preferred days: Tue/Wed/Thu (PST). We are flexible on exact times but prefer late-morning to avoid regional maintenance windows.

Attaching a tentative slot matrix. Can you confirm who on your side needs to be on the call and what infra reservations are required?

Thanks,
Sam
Ops Lead, StratusCloud

Attachment: load-test-window-options.csv (CSV)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ops Lead <ops@stratuscloud.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scaling rehearsal + benchmark window next week

Sam — thanks for the clear asks. We can support this but need to lock two things before confirming a slot:

1) A reserved Dedicated cluster for the 3-hour window (we can spin a 4-GPU group and pin the model variant)
2) A short pre-check with our infra lead to validate your payload profile and to confirm prefix/KV caching expectations (30m)

Proposed plan:
- Mon 10/13 09:30–10:00 PT: pre-check (30m)
- Tue 10/14 10:00–13:00 PT: rehearsal + ramped benchmark + readout (3h)

If Tue doesn't work we can swap to Wed 10/15 same times. Priyom and Dylan are briefed — Priyom will own cluster reservation and Dylan will run the benchmark harness.

Ill attach a rehearsal checklist and token target spreadsheet for visibility. Please confirm the preferred day and whether your QA team needs a separate troubleshooting channel.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rehearsal-checklist.md (MD), token-capacity-targets-v1.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: scaling rehearsal + benchmark window next week

Quick notes from infra:

- Cluster reservation: I can reserve 4x A100 (or equivalent) and pin the requested model variant for Tue 10/14 09:45–13:15 PT to allow a 15m buffer for pre-checks. I need full model artifact name and quantization profile by EOD Friday to stage images.
- Network: well throttle external traffic shaping on our side to simulate Stratus production egress. Please confirm your source IP ranges for firewall whitelisting.
- Observability: set up tracing hooks and a dedicated log group. Dylan, can you add the custom sampling rules (span name: token_emit) to the harness?

If we dont get the artifact, we fallback to the latest verified build and note it in the readout.

—Priyom
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ops Lead <ops@stratuscloud.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: QA Manager <qa@stratuscloud.io>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scaling rehearsal + benchmark window next week

Thanks — Tue 10/14 works best. Confirming:

- Model artifact: stratus/gptx-12b:v3-quant (well deliver the artifact link and SHA256 by Friday 17:00 PT)
- Source IPs: 54.201.44.10/32, 54.201.44.11/32, qa.stratuscloud.io (we can provide a CIDR if needed)
- QA wants a parallel channel; please add a Google Meet link and well have an on-call QA engineer available for the readout.

Also, can you confirm the target pass criteria so the readout can call it a success? Proposed pass criteria: sustained 95th percentile latency < 350ms at the steady-state target and no model-ejection events during the ramp.

Sam
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ops Lead <ops@stratuscloud.io>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Tue 10/14 rehearsal + benchmark (calendar invite & runbook)

All — confirmed and calendared. Summary / action items:

- Slot: Tue 2025-10-14 09:45–13:15 PT (includes 15m buffer + 3h window)
- Pre-check: Mon 2025-10-13 09:30–10:00 PT (Michael, Priyom, Sam, Stratus QA)
- Infra: Priyom to reserve 4x A100-equivalent and stage the artifact (deadline: Fri 10/10 17:00 PT)
- Harness: Dylan to update sampling rule (span name: token_emit) and share the runner config by EOD Mon
- Firewall: Michael to confirm whitelisting once we receive the CIDR/IPs from Sam
- Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency < 350ms at steady-state; zero model-ejection events during ramp.

Links: rehearsal checklist and token targets are attached; Drive folder and JIRA ticket are listed in the metadata. Calendar invite has been sent to all participants; Meet link included.

If anything changes Ill update the invite. Looking forward to the run.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
